Note:
- **Different critical resources** require **different mutex semaphores**.
- **P and V operations must appear in pairs**. Missing ⟦MC_c080a9d828301512_1⟧ means **mutually exclusive access to the critical resource cannot be guaranteed**. Missing ⟦MC_e9b079a57ebdea94_1⟧ will cause **the resource to never be released, and waiting processes to never be woken up**.
